open: No ticket office listed by DSB (Wikipedia still mentions one; DSB page is newer).
OSM platforms (5 ways) carry no refs, so lifts/stairs are not linked to perron 1 (spor 0/1) or 2 (spor 3/4); which platform each lift reaches is unsettled. OSM shows only two lifts, both 0;-1.
Kennedy Arkaden next door: not included (not part of the station).
Second toilet node n11047578514 (68 m, outside the building) not identified.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.
